title: Bee Removal in Yonkers, Westchester
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Yonkers, Westchester. Licensed nest treatment and removal from homes and businesses.
intro: Stinging insect problems in Yonkers? The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee removal services throughout Westchester's fourth-largest city, from Getty Square to the historic Hudson River waterfront. Our licensed technicians locate and treat nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, chimneys, and structural wood across all Yonkers neighborhoods.
whyUs: With years of experience serving Yonkers and Westchester County, our certified bee removal specialists use humane, eco-friendly methods to relocate bees while protecting your property. We provide same-day or next-day service, transparent pricing between $350-$550, and a satisfaction guarantee for all Yonkers residents.
localContext: Yonkers' mix of historic Victorian homes, modern apartment complexes, and commercial districts along Central Avenue creates ideal wasp and hornet nesting sites in chimneys, attics, soffits, wall voids, and building facades. From the hillside neighborhoods near Sarah Lawrence College to the waterfront developments at iPark, paper wasp nests, bald-faced hornet colonies, and yellow jacket ground burrows are common throughout New York's fourth-largest city. Carpenter bees drilling galleries into eaves and trim are a recurring structural issue in older wood-sided homes.
